logged_erasure: Retains every other state field; erasing logs is an observation, not rollback.
three_static: Arbitrary three byte lists, not a typed/admitted event execution.
three_words_transport: Three bounded words; exact ordered bytes, no canonical argument/layout relation.
logged_payload_injective: Retains equality of full logged states with identical global/frame/event/types/prestate. Premise is not established for different payloads; no hash injectivity or unconditional log equality.

limitations: All original event targets indexed exactly once, not full semantic census or joint/fidelity acceptance. Prior application gates remain historical; no new Lean/current full gate/timing claim. Source admission and canonical H68 transport remain open.
